parameters.description: If true, response will include the number of field sets using item (custom field).

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.1/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/custom_field_definitions?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&tool_name=SOME_STRING_VALUE&includes_configurable_field_sets_count=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bwith_label%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
